name: YT Beatmaker Stems Pack (optional)
description: Optional local stem separation. Dormant unless installed via the Stems menu. Browser-only; works on macOS and Windows.
runtime: onnxruntime-web (MIT, vendored separately) + public HT-Demucs ONNX export (MIT)

cache.session: memory-only (cleared on tab close / video change)

notes: Model is downloaded only on installation, detected by verified bytes after reload, and erased on uninstall. Analysis starts automatically when an installed model and video are available. Whole-audio preloading is attempted on launch (64 MB / ten-minute limit), with automatic capture fallback. Capture results require replay of processed sections; unavailable sections and non-1x playback use original audio, never frequency-band substitutes.
